name: vscode-extension-open-workspace
description: Automatically opens a workspace file (.code-workspace) if it exists in the current directory or workspace root upon opening VS Code.

openWorkspaceIfExists.enabled.description: Enable automatic workspace detection and opening on startup.

openWorkspaceIfExists.confirmBeforeOpen.description: Show a confirmation popup before opening a single matching workspace.

openWorkspaceIfExists.createWorkspaceIfM.description: Offer to create and open a workspace file if no matching workspace is found.

openWorkspaceIfExists.confirmBeforeCreat.description: Show a confirmation before creating a workspace file. Disable to create it automatically.

openWorkspaceIfExists.workspaceFileCreat.description: Initial folder for the new workspace file picker. Empty uses workspacesFolder if it exists, otherwise the opened folder. Relative paths resolve from it. Supports ${env:NAME}.

openWorkspaceIfExists.pattern.description: File glob pattern to search for workspaces.

openWorkspaceIfExists.workspacesFolder.description: Folder searched (recursively) for .code-workspace files that contain the currently opened folder. If several match, you are asked to choose one.
